title: Rafael and the Echo
author: Sebastian Winterbourne
blurb: Rafael Vasquez, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
